descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S10 Existing specs: photo reading is wired to Vertex Gemini and the prompt goes in unchanged

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 A photographed prior note is read by Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is used word for word with only the request format adapted, and the read text ke … (TFA-94425 AC 1; TFA-94425 AC 2; TFA-94425 AC 3; TFA-94425 AC 4)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Provider configuration (api project, no network)

When Read the default vision provider and model, route a photo, build the Vertex request

Then The default vision provider is Vertex with a Gemini Flash model. A photo goes to the configured model with the prompt text unchanged, in the native Vertex request shape

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in api/providers.spec.ts. This covers defaults and wiring only. DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL is gemini-3.6-flash, the model that returned 404 on dev before PR #102. Which model really answered is S21; word-for-word parity is S25

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-13 Previous Notes · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-13/S10

Existing specs: photo reading is wired to Vertex Gemini and the prompt goes in unchanged

Tickets: TFA-94425 Implement Vision/photo path (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-13.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — defaults photo OCR to Google Vertex Gemini — expected
  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — builds the native Vertex photo OCR request with literal-reading controls — expected
  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — routes photos using the explicit vision provider and model — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/providers.spec.ts): it checks the worktree's provider code in-process and calls no deployment, so there is nothing to run on dev; it runs with the local suite (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
